feature: Auth Core: Sign-in + MFA challenge (Feature #1648). Real screens rebuilt from scratch against Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/screens/Auth Sign-In.dc.html and Auth MFA Challenge.dc.html, superseding the retired portal-v2 login page this file used to cover (that page and its #email/#password/[data-testid='login-submit'] IDs no longer exist -- artifacts/msp-portal was retired wholesale). Wired to the real POST /api/auth/login (auth.ts:321-418) and, on an mfaRequired response, an inline MFA-challenge phase of the SAME page (not a separate route) wired to POST /api/auth/mfa/totp/challenge and POST /api/auth/mfa/bypass (mfa.ts).
notes: shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- these assertions only go green once this session's commit is deployed by the dev-server rebuild.

No known-password test account exists in the local DB for a real end-to-end 401/423/mfaRequired assertion here without writing one -- see auth/password-reset-guard.json for the forgot-password API coverage, which needs no credential. This manifest covers the real page load + form wiring; the credential-branch banners (invalid/locked/mfaRequired) were verified by direct route reading against docs/portal/auth-core-contract-pack.md, not exercised end-to-end here.
Route is /portal/login (this app mounts at /portal/, no slug prefix for the auth flow).
